changed_core.multi_cut: 各φ_l=max_(s_l)G_l的非负权和等max_(s1,…,sL)Σμ_lG_l，须每cut自己的hidden。两函数状态值分别(1,0)/(0,1)，各max和2、共态max和1。先合并原行再投影可另得合法必要行，但不是原各cut正权和；压成h后仍各用h_l。

preserved_mathematical_boundaries.physical_SPE_repair_gap: Causal replay is a full-history approximate plan or an auxiliary-tax SPE. To use a smaller-population physical theorem, one still needs either all-history Gamma≥Rdev−Robey, or a genuine physical full-SPE repair whose signed welfare change has the upper direction needed by induction, together with the same optimal coverage population marginal. Fixed-leaf LOSS/H/M/prescribed suffix balances do not give these.
preserved_mathematical_boundaries.fixed_graph_domain: Current CAG coverage mapping is noninjective. B with two pairs of alias labels is legal; the historical set-catalog passage is a strict subdomain and B is not its strict-four-cover attainment witness.
preserved_mathematical_boundaries.shared_quantifiers: All K−/gamma/I/C/D/G/P/X/J in a logical use are from one full sigma and one true optimal saddle; strong all-query gamma≤W/m is stronger than existential gamma/2. Conditional edges do not promote open candidates to proved.
